$comment: Field maps for the fillable character sheets a pregen can be printed onto.
Edition and template are independent axes. The edition decides what a
level-5 wizard IS; the template decides what the boxes are CALLED. The WotC
fillable sheet has 334 fields and the D&D Beyond export of the same 2014
character has 775, sharing only 65 names. So each template carries its own
map, and adding a form is adding an entry here rather than editing the
generator.
Independent cuts both ways: one form can print several editions. A template
lists the editions it covers, and the WotC fillable sheet covers both, since
a 2024 character writes the same values into the same boxes. What actually
changed between editions is the names of TABLE COLUMNS, and those live in
the progression cache rather than on the paper.
The `sha256` pins the blank PDF. If a publisher reissues the sheet with
renamed boxes, the build fails instead of silently producing sheets with
empty spaces where the renamed fields used to be.
The names were extracted from the template, never retyped. Several carry
whitespace that looks like a typo and is not: `Race `, `DEXmod `,
`Deception `, `Wpn3 AtkBonus  ` (two trailing), `SpellSaveDC  2` (two
internal). Read them with scripts/content/sheet-fields.mjs --names.
The blanks themselves live in the vault, never in this repo:
DnD/01 Systems/dnd5e/Pregens/templates/.

wotc-fillable.label: WotC official fillable character sheet
wotc-fillable.editionNotes: Prints both editions. Measured: a 2024 character writes the same 58 values and every one has a box. Two known gaps, both cosmetic: the box is labelled RACE where 2024 says Species, and there is no weapon-mastery box (that column is not printed for either edition).
